description: The file defines API endpoints for managing a user's wishlist in a backend service. It includes route handlers for fetching, adding, and removing products from the wishlist, using FastAPI.

methods.name: str get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id"))
methods.description: Extracts and validates the user ID from the 'X-User-Id' header, raising an HTTP 400 error if missing.

methods.name: WishlistResponse get_wishlist(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's wishlist as a list of Product objects.

methods.name: None add(product_id: int, user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a product to the user's wishlist by product ID.

methods.name: None remove(product_id: int, user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a product from the user's wishlist by product ID.

ctags.name: add
ctags.pattern: /^def add(product_id: int, user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get_user_id
ctags.pattern: /^def get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id")) -> str:$/

ctags.name: remove
ctags.pattern: /^def remove(product_id: int, user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id)) -> None:$/
